@matchYou.description: The signed-in player's own side in a match.

@matchYourOpponent.description: Stands in for the opponent's name mid-sentence when it isn't known yet.

@matchYourOpponentStart.description: Stands in for the opponent's name at the start of a sentence.

@matchTheScore.description: Stands in for a reported score mid-sentence when it isn't known.

@matchScoreWithPens.description: A score with a penalty shootout, from the player's side.

matchStepOpponentFromEarlierRound: Your opponent comes from an earlier round.
